prd: PRD-15 Parent Portal — Child Switcher, Absence Notes & Conference Booking (SCH-015)

functionalRequirements.description: Add Prisma enums AbsenceNoteStatus, AbsenceReason, ConsentResponseValue and models AbsenceNote, ConferenceEvent, ConferenceSlot, ConsentForm, ConsentAudience, ConsentResponse exactly as specified, with a migration; reuse existing AudienceType enum (GRADE_LEVEL/SECTION/COURSE only for consent).
AbsenceNote validation: toDate >= fromDate, span <= 30 days, details <= 1,000 chars, periodIds used only when partialDay; ConferenceEvent.slotMinutes 5–60; ConferenceSlot.parentNote <= 500 chars.
PARENT users with 2+ linked children see a top-bar child switcher (avatar + first name dropdown); selection stored in cookie sh_child.
sh_child cookie is validated against ParentStudentLink on every request; an invalid/unlinked value falls back to the first child.
Parent-facing pages accepting studentId (timetable, assignments, grades, calendar filter) default to the selected child, replacing per-page child selectors; ?studentId= remains an override.
Parents with exactly one child see that child's name in the top bar with no dropdown.

/my-children replaces the PRD-03 'My children' list: one-child parents redirect to /my-children/[studentId]; multi-child parents see cards with attendance rate this term, missing-assignment count and average grade linking to each overview.
Child overview is the default landing page for parents after sign-in (within 2 clicks of sign-in).
Overview 'Today' card shows the child's schedule for today or a holiday message (PRD-06/14 data).
Overview 'Attendance' card shows term rate, absences and lates this term, last 5 marks and a 'Report an absence' button.
Overview 'Assignments' card shows missing assignments (red) and those due in the next 7 days.
Overview 'Recent grades' card shows last 5 returned/visible grades with course and score, plus current percent per course.
Overview 'Announcements' card shows the last 3 unread announcements for this child.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-15 FR-3.2 Announcements (PRD-12 Announcement model not present in workspace)

functionalRequirements.description: Overview 'Upcoming events' card shows the next 5 calendar items.
Overview 'Teachers' card lists the child's teachers with subject and a 'Message' button (PRD-13 messaging).
Overview 'Action items' card lists pending consent forms and open conference bookings.
Each overview card has a 'View all' link to the full page/tab and loads independently via React Suspense streaming.

Parent absence form at /my-children/[studentId]/absence/new: from/to dates (past 14 days to 60 days ahead), whole day or specific periods (checkboxes from bell schedule), reason, details, optional PDF/JPG/PNG upload with file context 'absence-note'.
On submit the note is PENDING and notifies the homeroom teacher and admins via notify() type absence_note.submitted (default email false).
Parents see a list of their absence notes with status.

Review queue /attendance/absence-notes for homeroom TEACHER (own section) and ADMIN (all), filterable by status and date; each note shows student, dates, reason, details, document link and existing attendance records for those dates.
Reviewers can Approve (optional note) or Reject (note required); reviewedById, reviewNote, reviewedAt are recorded.

Approval sets every matching attendance record (dates, and periods if partial) with status ABSENT or no record yet to EXCUSED with note 'Absence note #<id>', writes audit(), and attendance rate recalculates; rejected notes leave records unchanged.
For future dates an approved note pre-fills students as EXCUSED with an 'Absence note' badge when a register is later taken; teachers may still change it.
Teachers may select EXCUSED in the register only when an approved note covers that student/date/period; ADMIN can always set EXCUSED (relaxes current ADMIN-only rule in attendance-service).
Parent is notified of the review decision including the reviewer's note (absence_note.reviewed, default email true).
PRD-07 attendance.absent notifications are suppressed for a student when a PENDING or APPROVED note covers that date/period.

Admin creates/edits ConferenceEvent at /admin/conferences (title, date, booking window, slot length, eligible grade levels); teachers teaching eligible students are notified (conference.slots_requested).

Teacher availability page /conferences/[id]/availability: pick time ranges and location; system regenerates unbooked slots of slotMinutes; teachers can remove unbooked slots and block individual slots.

Parent booking page /conferences/[id] shows, for each of the selected child's teachers with slots, available slots as time buttons; booking is atomic (UPDATE … WHERE bookedByParentId IS NULL) with an optional note.
Booking rules: max one slot per teacher per child; overlapping bookings with other teachers are rejected with message 'You already have a meeting with <teacher> at <time>'.
Reschedule = cancel + book; cancellation allowed until bookingClosesAt (booking only within booking window).
Booking/cancellation notifies parent and teacher (conference.booked, conference.cancelled) with an .ics attachment link.
Teacher day view lists booked slots in order with student, parent and note, and is printable.
Booked conference slots appear on both parties' calendars as PRD-14 source 'My meetings'.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-15 FR-5.7 (PRD-14 calendar UI/aggregation not present in workspace)

functionalRequirements.description: Admins (any audience) and teachers (courses they manage) create consent forms at /consent-forms/new with title, Markdown description, due date, optional linked CalendarEvent, audience; parents of audience students notified (consent.requested, default email true).

Parents see pending consent forms on the child overview and at /consent-forms; responding requires Granted/Declined and a typed signature matching the parent's name case-insensitively, plus optional comment.
One response per student (any linked parent); responses may be changed until dueAt and every change is audited.
Creator/admin tracking page shows per-student status (Granted, Declined, No response) with filters, CSV export (?format=csv), and 'Remind non-responders' throttled to once per 24 hours.
Maintenance run sends a reminder 48 hours before dueAt to parents with no response.
Register file context 'absence-note' readable by the submitting parent, other linked parents, homeroom teacher and admins.
Navigation entries: Parents — My children, Absence notes, Conferences, Consent forms; Teachers — Absence notes (homeroom only), Conferences; Admins — Conferences, Consent forms, Absence notes.

Implement the REST API table (me/children/summary, students/:id/overview, absence-notes CRUD/review, conferences, availability, slots, book/cancel, consent-forms, responses, tracking, remind) with role checks enforced server-side via requireRole/access helpers and the standard response/error shapes.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-15 API table; Platform Context conventions

functionalRequirements.description: Register new notification types absence_note.submitted, absence_note.reviewed, conference.slots_requested, conference.booked, conference.cancelled, consent.requested (and consent reminder) in src/server/notifications/types.ts.
functionalRequirements.source: PRD-15 FR-4/5/6 notify keys; Platform Context notifications rule (reminder key name not specified)

functionalRequirements.description: Seed data: one pending and one approved absence note for Grade 7; 'Autumn conferences' 3 weeks out for Grade 7 with Tom and Tina slots 15:00–17:00 (10 min), two booked; consent form 'Science Museum Trip' for Grade 7 due in 10 days linked to a calendar event with 40% responses.

Tests: unit (absence coverage matching whole-day/periods/multi-day, slot generation, signature match); integration (approval updates/pre-fill, concurrent atomic booking, notification suppression); Playwright (absence note → approve → register EXCUSED; book conference slot; sign consent).

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Concurrency: two simultaneous bookings of the same slot → exactly one succeeds; the other gets 'That slot was just taken' (409 CONFLICT) and refreshed slots.
Performance: child overview first section paints < 1 s; full page < 2 s.
Auditability: absence approvals, consent responses and changes write AuditLog entries including IP address.

UI component rule: Material UI only (@mui/material v9, icons, MUI X data-grid/date-pickers/charts/scheduler); every component looked up via mui-mcp (useMuiDocs + fetchDocs) before use; banned libraries (Tailwind, shadcn, Radix, Chakra, lucide-react, notistack, etc.) never imported; toasts via shared useToast(), confirmations via Dialog, pickers via Autocomplete; MCP unreachable = blocker. QA must verify.
nonFunctionalRequirements.source: PRD-15 Platform Context — UI component rule (item 6 mandates recording as NFR)

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Security/access: every handler and server page enforces access server-side; parents only for linked students, homeroom teachers only for their section, consent tracking only creator/admin.
nonFunctionalRequirements.source: PRD-15 Platform Context — Roles; code conventions

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Brownfield: reuse existing models/services/components/helpers (audit(), notify(), files contexts, attendance-service, AudienceType/audience.ts, DataTable, FileUpload, MarkdownView, ConfirmDialog, UserAvatar); new services in src/server/<feature>/<feature>-service.ts; no renames, no re-scaffolding.
nonFunctionalRequirements.source: PRD-15 Platform Context — Code layout and conventions

nonFunctionalRequirements.description: Quality gates: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test stay green; TypeScript strict; Zod validators in src/lib/validators/<feature>.ts shared by forms and handlers; no console.log (use logger).
Date handling: timestamps stored UTC, displayed and date rules (absence windows, 'today', due dates, 48h reminder) evaluated in SchoolSettings.timezone; date-only fields use @db.Date.
Scope: deliver in a single forge run; no payments, pickup/transport, or parent self-registration; do not modify behaviour owned by PRD-16+.
Lists use standard pagination (?page, ?pageSize ≤100), sorting and ?q search where applicable.
